largest-contentful-paint.title: Largest Contentful Paint
largest-contentful-paint.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)

first-contentful-paint.title: First Contentful Paint
first-contentful-paint.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/)

render-blocking-resources.title: Eliminate render-blocking resources
render-blocking-resources.description: Resources are blocking the first paint of your page. [Learn how to eliminate render-blocking resources](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/render-blocking-resources/).

image-alt.title: Image elements do not have `[alt]` attributes
image-alt.description: Informative elements should aim for short, descriptive alternate text. [Learn more about the `alt` attribute](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/image-alt).

color-contrast.title: Background and foreground colors have a sufficient contrast ratio
color-contrast.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read.

meta-description.title: Document does not have a meta description
meta-description.description: Meta descriptions may be included in search results to concisely summarize page content. [Learn more about the meta description](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/meta-description/).

errors-in-console.title: Browser errors were logged to the console
errors-in-console.description: Errors logged to the console indicate unresolved problems. [Learn more about this errors in console diagnostic audit](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/best-practices/errors-in-console/)

inspector-issues.title: No issues in the `Issues` panel in Chrome Devtools
